channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lonnie Walker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lonnie Walker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Luke Kornet on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Luke Kornet on Lonnie Walker:

“He's a great player and honestly his energy, joy and passion...that he just innately possesses is awesome. I never really had the opportunity to know him closely until these past few weeks, and he's been great to have around and a joy to play with.”

Luke Kornet on Lonnie Walker, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Derrick White on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Derrick White on Lonnie Walker:

“Hell of an athlete. A guy who wants to learn and wants to grow. He has a great attitude every day, comes in and is competing, is learning. It's been nice reconnecting with him like the old days. He's continuing to grow, learn the system, learn what we need and want him to do.”

Derrick White on Lonnie Walker, Sep 29, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Dennis Schroder on the Nets roster:

“We’ve got a lot of talent... I remember when Mikal and Cam were on Phoenix and we played them in the 1st round. Really, really talented players. Lonnie, we made it last year to the Western Conference Finals; he had really big games for us.”

Dennis Schroder on Lonnie Walker, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on what Lonnie Walker has shown this season:

“He shouldn't be a minimum player in this league. We're very fortunate to have him on a minimum... This is a guy that without a doubt belongs at a place that he can call home and hopefully that’s here for us.”

Jacque Vaughn on Lonnie Walker, Feb 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Lonnie Walker IV:

“He got a workout in today, and he will not play tomorrow. But there's some good signs pointing towards him playing when we get back home.”

Jacque Vaughn on Lonnie Walker, Jan 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Anthony Davis, Lonnie Walker, Austin Reaves
item.description:
“We have now a stretch of hopefully a couple weeks before the trade deadline where we’ll get a chance to hopefully get healthy with guys like Austin Reaves, Lonnie Walker and Anthony Davis coming back into the mix for us,”

Rob Pelinka on Anthony Davis, Lonnie Walker, Austin Reaves, Jan 25, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Pop on Walker's career night:

“He played a great game, hit shots, made good decisions, busted his butt on defense.”

Gregg Popovich on Lonnie Walker, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Asked if Lonnie Walker (back) is participating in group practice after being limited most of the first week to individual, non-contact work, Rudy Gay said,

“Yeah, Lonnie is out there with us. Lonnie is being Lonnie. Everybody knows what Lonnie can do and how important he is.”

Rudy Gay on Lonnie Walker, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Lonnie's growth:

“He's going through the process of becoming a pro & understanding what wins & what loses. Making good decisions on both ends, knowing what he can do to help us win. For a young player, that is a process & he's doing well.”

Gregg Popovich on Lonnie Walker, Jan 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Derrick White on Lonnie Walker
item.description:
Derrick White on playing with second unit:

“It’s been fun – Patty, Belli, Rudy, Lonnie. Just running around, finding the shooters out there. The floor is open. It’s been fun. It’s been cool. Whatever coach wants me to do, I do. I’ve been enjoying it.”

Derrick White on Lonnie Walker, Oct 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
